# Founder-led sales coaching from Lenny's startup playbook

Curated by Skill Harbor — @refoundai's skill for founder-led sales, distilled from 6 guests and posts across Lenny's Podcast and Newsletter: a 4-step coaching workflow (assess whether you have enough validation to start selling or are hiring a salesperson too early, refine the founder narrative and value proposition, design a high-volume discovery-and-closing process, overcome the psychological hurdles like fear of asking for money), core principles (leverage founder status because "the founder is the product" in the early days, treat sales as a learnable discipline, make the direct financial ask, run discovery yourself at volume, build human trust), a templates-and-frameworks list (the Collison Install, the $1 Invoice Test, warm-intro-by-text technique, founder-led sales readiness checklist, B2B maturity stages), probing questions for sales calls, and common mistakes to flag (hiring sales too early, playing the feature game, avoiding the commercial ask). Honest caveats: coaching methodology, not software — the deep-dive guest insights live in the repo's references/guest-insights.md, and the related skills "Evaluating Startup Ideas" and "Fundraising" mentioned in the skill are not bundled here. MIT licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
